scope: same V9 development domain used for model fitting; mechanism integration only, not independent confirmation
architecture: unchanged ANS global-goal/local-action hierarchy and OV-SDF, STGHP, RPN-UQ, IGCR interfaces
candidate_contract: rate_single candidates and complete safe round-trip option execution match the frozen V9 training action unit
online_feedback: fractional Beta camera-yield residual indexed by measured category sign, quantized instance center and eight-sector view direction; two observations are required and correction is clipped to plus/minus 25 percent; evaluator truth is unavailable online
input_guard: each out-of-range candidate independently falls back to the equal-capacity geometry MLP
metrics: primary joint gain = terminal 2D covered area times F1@5cm minus the shared-prefix value
secondary inspection joint = new visible 3D surface area times terminal global F1@5cm
path distance, action time, collision and safe return
failure_policy: retain every branch and failed gate; do not open independent E confirmation until a new development version passes
